meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并编辑带格式的Word文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会把你提到的 Word 文档需求变成实际文件操作：新建、读取、编辑 .docx/.dotx 文件，给文档加目录、标题、页码等，还能插入图片、查找替换、加批注和修订，并输出可用的 Word 文档。
howto.when: 当你说到“Word 文档”、“.docx”或要求生成“报告”等，或请它读取、编辑、提取内容、处理图片/批注/修订时，它就会接管。

say.text: 把这段文字做成 Word 文档，要目录和页码。
say.note: 它会生成并交付一个 .docx 文件。

say.text: 把 report.docx 里的“旧方案”全部改成“新方案”。
say.note: 它会直接编辑这个文档并保存。

say.text: 在 contract.docx 里给“费用上限太低”加批注，并做一份修订记录。
say.note: 它会在对应位置加上批注和修订痕迹。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will create, read, edit, or modify Word documents (.docx) and templates (.dotx) on request. It can handle headings, tables of contents, page numbers, images, find-and-replace, comments, and tracked changes, and deliver content as a usable Word file.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you mention "Word document", ".docx", or "report", or ask it to read, edit, extract, insert images, or work with comments and tracked changes in Word files.

say_en.text: Turn this text into a Word doc with a heading and page numbers.
say_en.note: Claude creates and delivers a .docx file.

say_en.text: In report.docx, replace every "old plan" with "new plan".
say_en.note: Claude edits and saves the document.

say_en.text: In contract.docx, add a comment after "fee cap is too low" and make a tracked change.
say_en.note: Claude anchors a comment and tracks the revision there.
